newsitem.title: USA: EPIX Medical says in deal with Dyax Corp.
newsitem.headline: EPIX Medical says in deal with Dyax Corp.

text.p: EPIX Medical Inc said Wednesday it formed an alliance with the privately held Dyax Corp to develop products for the diagnosis of severe blood clots in the lungs and legs.
Under the terms of the agreement, the two companies will use Dyax technology, and EPIX will fund a screening program and provide expertise in MRI contrast technology.
Dyax will assume primary responsibility for developing agents for use in nuclear medicine.
Dyax will receive royalties on sales of MRI products, and EPIX will receive royalties on sales of nuclear medicine products resulting from this collaboration.
